mapper.select: WITH impression_raw AS ( SELECT DATE(i.created_at) AS dt, i.huagao_id, MAX(i.shangjia_id) AS shangjia_id, COUNT(*) AS impression_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN i.keyword IS NOT NULL AND i.keyword <> '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS search_impression_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN i.fenlei IS NOT NULL AND i.fenlei <> '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS filter_fenlei_impression_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN i.tag_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS filter_tag_impression_cnt FROM rec_huagao_impression_log i WHERE DATE(i.created_at) = #{dt} GROUP BY DATE(i.created_at), i.huagao_id ), action_raw AS ( SELECT DATE(a.created_at) AS dt, a.huagao_id, MAX(a.shangjia_id) AS shangjia_id, SUM(CASE WHEN a.event_type = 'click_detail' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS click_detail_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN a.event_type = 'favorite' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS favorite_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN a.event_type = 'click_detail' AND COALESCE(r.has_search, 0) = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS search_click_detail_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN a.event_type = 'favorite' AND COALESCE(r.has_search, 0) = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS search_favorite_cnt FROM rec_huagao_action_log a LEFT JOIN rec_huagao_request_log r ON r.request_id = a.request_id WHERE DATE(a.created_at) = #{dt} GROUP BY DATE(a.created_at), a.huagao_id ), keyset AS ( SELECT dt, huagao_id FROM impression_raw UNION SELECT dt, huagao_id FROM action_raw UNION SELECT dt, huagao_id FROM rec_huagao_item_stat_daily WHERE dt = #{dt} ) SELECT k.dt, k.huagao_id, COALESCE(d.shangjia_id, i.shangjia_id, a.shangjia_id) AS shangjia_id, COALESCE(i.impression_cnt, 0) AS raw_impression_cnt, COALESCE(d.impression_cnt, 0) AS agg_impression_cnt, COALESCE(a.click_detail_cnt, 0) AS raw_click_detail_cnt, COALESCE(d.click_detail_cnt, 0) AS agg_click_detail_cnt, COALESCE(a.favorite_cnt, 0) AS raw_favorite_cnt, COALESCE(d.favorite_cnt, 0) AS agg_favorite_cnt, COALESCE(i.search_impression_cnt, 0) AS raw_search_impression_cnt, COALESCE(d.search_impression_cnt, 0) AS agg_search_impression_cnt, COALESCE(i.filter_fenlei_impression_cnt, 0) AS raw_filter_fenlei_impression_cnt, COALESCE(d.filter_fenlei_impression_cnt, 0) AS agg_filter_fenlei_impression_cnt, COALESCE(i.filter_tag_impression_cnt, 0) AS raw_filter_tag_impression_cnt, COALESCE(d.filter_tag_impression_cnt, 0) AS agg_filter_tag_impression_cnt, COALESCE(a.search_click_detail_cnt, 0) AS raw_search_click_detail_cnt, COALESCE(d.search_click_detail_cnt, 0) AS agg_search_click_detail_cnt, COALESCE(a.search_favorite_cnt, 0) AS raw_search_favorite_cnt, COALESCE(d.search_favorite_cnt, 0) AS agg_search_favorite_cnt, CASE WHEN COALESCE(i.impression_cnt, 0) = COALESCE(d.impression_cnt, 0) AND COALESCE(a.click_detail_cnt, 0) = COALESCE(d.click_detail_cnt, 0) AND COALESCE(a.favorite_cnt, 0) = COALESCE(d.favorite_cnt, 0) AND COALESCE(i.search_impression_cnt, 0) = COALESCE(d.search_impression_cnt, 0) AND COALESCE(i.filter_fenlei_impression_cnt, 0) = COALESCE(d.filter_fenlei_impression_cnt, 0) AND COALESCE(i.filter_tag_impression_cnt, 0) = COALESCE(d.filter_tag_impression_cnt, 0) AND COALESCE(a.search_click_detail_cnt, 0) = COALESCE(d.search_click_detail_cnt, 0) AND COALESCE(a.search_favorite_cnt, 0) = COALESCE(d.search_favorite_cnt, 0) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_match FROM keyset k LEFT JOIN impression_raw i ON i.dt = k.dt AND i.huagao_id = k.huagao_id LEFT JOIN action_raw a ON a.dt = k.dt AND a.huagao_id = k.huagao_id LEFT JOIN rec_huagao_item_stat_daily d ON d.dt = k.dt AND d.huagao_id = k.huagao_id ORDER BY is_match ASC, k.huagao_id ASC

WITH request_raw AS ( SELECT DATE(r.created_at) AS dt, r.query_key, MAX(r.scene) AS scene, MAX(r.keyword) AS keyword, MAX(r.normalized_keyword) AS normalized_keyword, MAX(r.fenlei) AS fenlei, MAX(r.tag_id) AS tag_id, MAX(r.has_search) AS has_search, MAX(r.has_fenlei_filter) AS has_fenlei_filter, MAX(r.has_tag_filter) AS has_tag_filter, COUNT(*) AS request_cnt FROM rec_huagao_request_log r WHERE DATE(r.created_at) = #{dt} GROUP BY DATE(r.created_at), r.query_key ), impression_raw AS ( SELECT DATE(i.created_at) AS dt, r.query_key, COUNT(*) AS impression_cnt FROM rec_huagao_impression_log i INNER JOIN rec_huagao_request_log r ON r.request_id = i.request_id WHERE DATE(i.created_at) = #{dt} GROUP BY DATE(i.created_at), r.query_key ), action_raw AS ( SELECT DATE(a.created_at) AS dt, r.query_key, SUM(CASE WHEN a.event_type = 'click_detail' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS click_detail_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN a.event_type = 'favorite' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS favorite_cnt FROM rec_huagao_action_log a INNER JOIN rec_huagao_request_log r ON r.request_id = a.request_id WHERE DATE(a.created_at) = #{dt} GROUP BY DATE(a.created_at), r.query_key ), keyset AS ( SELECT dt, query_key FROM request_raw UNION SELECT dt, query_key FROM impression_raw UNION SELECT dt, query_key FROM action_raw UNION SELECT dt, query_key FROM rec_huagao_query_stat_daily WHERE dt = #{dt} ) SELECT k.dt, k.query_key, COALESCE(d.scene, rq.scene) AS scene, COALESCE(d.keyword, rq.keyword) AS keyword, COALESCE(d.normalized_keyword, rq.normalized_keyword) AS normalized_keyword, COALESCE(d.fenlei, rq.fenlei) AS fenlei, COALESCE(d.tag_id, rq.tag_id) AS tag_id, COALESCE(rq.request_cnt, 0) AS raw_request_cnt, COALESCE(d.request_cnt, 0) AS agg_request_cnt, COALESCE(ir.impression_cnt, 0) AS raw_impression_cnt, COALESCE(d.impression_cnt, 0) AS agg_impression_cnt, COALESCE(ar.click_detail_cnt, 0) AS raw_click_detail_cnt, COALESCE(d.click_detail_cnt, 0) AS agg_click_detail_cnt, COALESCE(ar.favorite_cnt, 0) AS raw_favorite_cnt, COALESCE(d.favorite_cnt, 0) AS agg_favorite_cnt, CASE WHEN COALESCE(rq.request_cnt, 0) = COALESCE(d.request_cnt, 0) AND COALESCE(ir.impression_cnt, 0) = COALESCE(d.impression_cnt, 0) AND COALESCE(ar.click_detail_cnt, 0) = COALESCE(d.click_detail_cnt, 0) AND COALESCE(ar.favorite_cnt, 0) = COALESCE(d.favorite_cnt, 0) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_match FROM keyset k LEFT JOIN request_raw rq ON rq.dt = k.dt AND rq.query_key = k.query_key LEFT JOIN impression_raw ir ON ir.dt = k.dt AND ir.query_key = k.query_key LEFT JOIN action_raw ar ON ar.dt = k.dt AND ar.query_key = k.query_key LEFT JOIN rec_huagao_query_stat_daily d ON d.dt = k.dt AND d.query_key = k.query_key ORDER BY is_match ASC, k.query_key ASC

SELECT r.request_id, r.scene, r.user_id, r.visitor_id, r.session_id, r.keyword, r.normalized_keyword, r.fenlei, r.tag_id, r.page_no, r.page_size, r.sort_mode, r.has_search, r.has_fenlei_filter, r.has_tag_filter, i.huagao_id, i.shangjia_id, i.position, i.search_score, i.created_at AS impression_at, COALESCE(a.click_detail_cnt, 0) AS click_detail_cnt, COALESCE(a.favorite_cnt, 0) AS favorite_cnt, a.first_click_detail_at, a.first_favorite_at, CASE WHEN COALESCE(a.favorite_cnt, 0) > 0 THEN 2 WHEN COALESCE(a.click_detail_cnt, 0) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS relevance, CASE WHEN COALESCE(a.favorite_cnt, 0) > 0 THEN 'favorite' WHEN COALESCE(a.click_detail_cnt, 0) > 0 THEN 'click_detail' ELSE 'impression' END AS label_source FROM rec_huagao_request_log r INNER JOIN rec_huagao_impression_log i ON i.request_id = r.request_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT request_id, huagao_id, SUM(CASE WHEN event_type = 'click_detail' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS click_detail_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN event_type = 'favorite' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS favorite_cnt, MIN(CASE WHEN event_type = 'click_detail' THEN created_at END) AS first_click_detail_at, MIN(CASE WHEN event_type = 'favorite' THEN created_at END) AS first_favorite_at FROM rec_huagao_action_log GROUP BY request_id, huagao_id ) a ON a.request_id = i.request_id AND a.huagao_id = i.huagao_id WHERE DATE(r.created_at) BETWEEN #{dateFrom} AND #{dateTo} ORDER BY r.created_at DESC, i.position ASC LIMIT #{limit}
